notes: Dane Avenue jogs at the horizontal street (y 3650): north part centre x~8000, south part (AVE 60') centre x~8220, recorded as two T's. The horizontal street at y~3650 carrying the 36in/18in sewers is not named in this strip; I take it to be Spring Grove Avenue since it curves into the diagonal AVENUE. The top east-west street (printed only '...STREET' at x~9300, 60') name not legible here: '?'. The '?' T at y 2615 is a short street labelled 'ST.' coming from the west. Dane Avenue is printed 'DANE' north of y 1500 and 'AVENUE' near y 3000.
